notes.title: Patch notes for July 18th
notes.content:
[p]It's finally time for old toys to get new upgrades![/p][p]Here's the list of what this patch contains:[/p][list][*][p]Minor spellcheck and grammar fixes [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where some renders were not appearing [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Lexi's scene was not obtainable [/p][/*][*][p]Added a default image for the new main menu wishlist ad to avoid having no image when there's no internet connection [/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugfixes and corrections

Best regards,
Inceton Games[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed a problem where some renders were not appearing
- Fixed a bug where Lexi's scene was not obtainable

tags.feature: - Added a default image for the new main menu wishlist ad to avoid having no image when there's no internet connection
